text: Blockchain Technology in Humanitarian Logistics Enhancing Transparency, Accountability and Real-Time Decision Making presents the following source proposition: Traditional aid supply chains often struggle with inefficiencies, information asymmetry, and limited traceability—challenges that blockchain addresses through secure, real-time, and tamper-proof data infrastructure. This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that Blockchain-based funds can invert the traditional secrecy of hedge funds: the LendingRobot ledger discloses detailed holdings and supplies a hash code signature evidencing that the data is tamper proof.
